basic_info.description: Charming top floor TIC unit near Golden Gate Park and Ocean. The sun filled unit features spacious layout with 3 bedrooms and a full bath with tub & shower plus a 1/2 bath. Open kitchen with granite counter tops connects to the dining room. Large Living Room with wood burning fireplace. Hardwood through out the unit. Washer & Dryer and a one car.  parking in the garage. Shared yard with a beautiful Magnolia tree. short walk to public transit, restaurants & shops.
